name: Can I stay in my home during a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can remain in your home, but you must set up an alternate meal-prep station because your kitchen will be out of service for weeks. Most homeowners set up a temporary kitchenette in a dining room, basement, or laundry area equipped with a microwave, toaster oven, electric kettle, and mini-fridge. You will also need access to a utility sink or bathroom sink for washing dishes. If the remodel involves extensive structural wall removals or main-floor flooring replacements across open spaces, some families choose to stay elsewhere during heavy demolition and drywall sanding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, most homeowners stay home by setting up a temporary prep area with a microwave and small fridge, though heavy dust and lack of running water require adjustment.
